subject: dsa
title: First Bad Version
summary: Versions go good then bad — a sorted boolean. Binary search the boundary: if mid is good, the first bad is to the right; if bad, it's here or to the left.
problem: Versions 1..n; after the first bad one, every later version is bad too. Find the first bad version with the fewest checks.

steps.caption: Versions 1 to 5. Once one is bad, every later version is bad too. Find the first bad one.
Binary search the version range [1, 5] instead of checking each in turn.
Version 3 is good, so the first bad one is later. Discard versions 1-3.
Version 4 is bad, and version 3 was good — so 4 is the first bad version.
